title: Case 028: New phone number in profile
initial_request: I need to replace the phone number on my H&V profile. I no longer have access to the old phone, and I want to use the bank’s approved confirmation process.
overview: Elowen Mercer first requested a profile phone-number change by email, explaining that her old phone was unavailable. After H&V completed its identification checks during an official-channel call, an agent started the secure profile-change process. Elowen then confirmed the change through the secure portal, which reported that the profile number had been updated. Her original email was a request, not authorisation.

next_action.summary: After completing the prescribed identification checks on the verified call, start H&V’s secure phone-number change process and leave confirmation to the customer.

outcome: The secure portal confirmed that the phone number in Elowen Mercer’s profile was updated after her confirmation. The earlier email was not treated as authorisation.

events.body: I need to change the phone number on my profile because I no longer have access to my old phone. Please tell me the approved way to confirm a replacement; this email is a request, not my authorisation to make the change.
After you completed H&V’s identification checks, I explained that the old phone is unavailable and asked for this to be escalated. I can confirm the replacement number through a secure bank process.

I have started the approved phone-number change process following the verified call. I have not changed the profile number or bypassed the old-device check; the customer must confirm the change securely.
Please review the replacement number entered in this secure process and confirm whether you want it applied to your profile. No change will be made until you confirm.
I have reviewed the replacement number in the secure process and confirm that I want it applied to my profile.
Phone number updated. The phone number in your profile has been updated following your secure confirmation.
